content.overview: Section 5 governs the articles of association: their mandatory registration with the memorandum, the option to adopt Table F (or other prescribed tables), the power to include additional regulations, and the binding effect of the articles on the company and its members.
content.glance: State that articles must be registered; note Table F default; explain that articles regulate internal management and bind the company and members.
content.study: The articles of association regulate the internal management of the company. Section 5 requires that the articles be registered with the memorandum. A company may adopt the model articles in Table F (or other prescribed tables for different company types) or register its own articles. Articles may contain regulations for management and matters incidental thereto. Entrenchment provisions may be included subject to the statutory conditions. The articles bind the company and the members as if they were signed by each member and contained covenants to observe them. Current-law framing: ground the analysis in s. 5 and distinguish articles from the memorandum under s. 4.

sections.heading: Registration with Memorandum
sections.body: Articles must be filed and registered with the memorandum under the incorporation process.

sections.heading: Model Articles (Table F)
sections.body: A company may adopt the model articles in the applicable Table or register custom articles.

sections.heading: Internal Management
sections.body: Articles regulate meetings, directors, shares, dividends and other internal matters.

sections.heading: Binding Effect
sections.body: Articles bind the company and members as contractual covenants inter se.

examples.title: Adoption of Table F
examples.body: A private company adopts Table F without modification. Section 5 is satisfied.

examples.title: Conflict with memorandum
examples.body: An article conflicts with a mandatory memorandum clause. The memorandum prevails on the conflict.

hypotheticals.question: Can articles override the memorandum?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. The memorandum is the charter; articles regulate internal management and cannot contradict the memorandum on fundamental matters.

hypotheticals.question: Are articles binding on outsiders?
hypotheticals.analysis: Articles primarily bind the company and members inter se; outsider rights depend on separate contract or statutory provision.

misconceptions.trap: Articles and memorandum are the same document.
misconceptions.correction: They serve different functions under ss. 4 and 5.
A company may adopt the prescribed model tables.

cases.name: Salomon v. A. Salomon & Co. Ltd.
cases.facts: Properly incorporated company challenged as indistinct from controller.
cases.ratioDecidendi: Registered company is a separate legal person.
cases.relevance: Already in file; articles form part of the incorporation package.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 5 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State the role of articles. II. Note registration and Table F option. III. Distinguish memorandum. IV. State binding effect. V. Conclude.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What should submissions contain?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Articles content; model vs custom; conflict with memorandum if any; binding effect; precise relief.

examTips: State the binding inter se effect.
